item.title: Kreider beats Hellebuyck in OT to lift the Ducks past the Jets, 5-4
item.description: ANAHEIM, Calif. (AP) — Chris Kreider beat Connor Hellebuyck off a rebound at 4:47 of overtime to give the Anaheim Ducks a 5-4 victory over the Winnipeg Jets on Friday night.

item.title: Emma Maltais scores go-ahead goal and the Toronto Sceptres beat the Seattle Torrent 5-2
item.description: SEATTLE (AP) — Emma Maltais scored a go-ahead goal early in the third period , and Sara Hjalmarsson and Kali Flanagan added empty netters in the final two minutes to give the Toronto Sceptres a 5-2 victory over the Seattle Torrent on Friday night.

item.title: Tempers flare between Nuggets and Thunder as Dort is ejected after fouling Jokic
item.description: OKLAHOMA CITY (AP) — Tempers flared in the fourth quarter of Oklahoma City's 127-121 overtime victory over the Denver Nuggets on Friday night and resulted in the ejection of the Thunder's Lu Dort.

item.title: Jalen Duren scores 33 as Pistons beat Cavaliers 122-119 in OT
item.description: DETROIT (AP) — Jalen Duren had 33 points and 16 rebounds and the Detroit Pistons outlasted the short-handed Cleveland Cavaliers 122-119 on Friday night in a game that was delayed for 18 minutes in the third quarter because of a blaring horn.

item.title: Cargo plane carrying money crashes near Bolivia's capital, killing at least 15 people, official says
item.description: LA PAZ, Bolivia (AP) — A cargo plane carrying money crashed Friday near Bolivia’s capital, damaging about a dozen vehicles on highway, scattering bills on the ground and leaving at least 15 people dead and others injured, an official said.

item.title: Israel's defense minister says his country has attacked Iran and declares a state of emergency
item.description: TEL AVIV, Israel (AP) — Israel launched an attack on Iran on Saturday, with the country’s defense minister declaring a state of emergency across the country.

item.title: Pierre-Luc Dubois scores 2 goals as the Capitals beat the Golden Knights 3-2
item.description: WASHINGTON (AP) — Pierre-Luc Dubois had two goals and an assist to lift the Washington Capitals to a 3-2 win over the Vegas Golden Knights on Friday night.
